page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-standard-192-lssd is a high-capacity server instance belonging to the c4n server family. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The system is equipped with 720.0 GB of system memory, which translates to an allocation of 3.75 GB of RAM per core.

A primary characteristic of this instance is its bundled local storage configuration. It includes 12,885 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across 32 local SSD devices. This storage is directly attached, providing high-capacity local block storage. The instance does not include any integrated GPUs, and it comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the massive local NVMe SSD capacity combined with 192 dedicated vCPUs, this instance is designed for I/O-intensive workloads. It is suitable for large-scale databases, high-throughput transactional systems, and data-intensive processing tasks that require low-latency local storage. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of dedicated compute resources and local NVMe storage reduces the need for external network-attached storage, optimizing resource utilization for storage-heavy deployments.
